SELF_ASSESSMENT.finding: Instances 10, 11 and 12 are one chain, all inside this document: a per-field misclassification, then a universal rule that over-corrected it, then a second universal rule with the same defect.
SELF_ASSESSMENT.generalisation: Over-correction is not the opposite of uneven application; it is the same error at a higher altitude. Fixing a case by promoting it to a universal skips the same step — testing the rule against the instances it now covers. In both cases the counterexample was already in the repository, load-bearing, two files away.
